tools.name: set_timer
tools.description: Set a timer for the specified duration or end time.

time_human.description: The duration or target end time in human readable format e.g. '45 minutes', 'at 13:30'.

tools.name: create_reminder
tools.description: Create a reminder that fires at a stated time. A reminder needs both a message and a time phrase; use add_task for undated to-dos.

message.description: What to be reminded about, copied word for word.

date_time_human.description: The user's date or time phrase copied word for word.

tools.name: create_calendar_event
tools.description: Create a calendar event with a title and start time. Copy both word for word; never rephrase or resolve them.

title.description: The event title copied word for word.

start_time_human.description: The start date or time phrase copied word for word.

location.description: The event location; include only when stated.

tools.name: add_task

title.description: The task copied word for word.

priority.description: low, medium, or high; include only when the user says a priority word.

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Save a free-form note. Notes store information; they never fire alerts.

text.description: The note content copied word for word.

title.description: A short note title; include only when the user names one.
